significance: A temple in Bangaon village of the Mithila region honouring the Vedic sage Bodhayan, author of the Baudhayana Sutras; its foundation was laid in 1956 by Devraha Baba with the Sanskrit scholar Sarvabhaum Vasudevacharya and the building finished in 1958 on twenty-five acres given by the villagers. A tank named Baudhayan Sarovar was dug beside it and an image of Vasudevacharya stands outside the shrine.
story: The site is held to be the birthplace of Bodhayan, and the old banyan tree in its grounds is remembered as the seat of his penance.
